text:
elena_cs: Weekly CloudBridge health check — p95/p99 latency by route/model, streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: non-streaming p99 spike on chat.generate(rwb-13b) yesterday 16:00-18:00, spend +12% w/w, error rate up to 0.8%. Posting quick metrics and actions.
elena_cs: ```
Period: 2026-03-16 -> 2026-03-22
Routes summary:
- chat.generate (rwb-13b)
  streaming: p95=210ms p99=480ms
  non-streaming: p95=230ms p99=920ms  <-- big p99 gap
- chat.generate (rwb-7b-quant)
  streaming: p95=180ms p99=340ms
  non-streaming: p95=200ms p99=370ms
- embeddings.embed (rwb-embed-2k)
  p95=45ms p99=70ms
Errors: overall 0.8% (peak 2.4% @17:12, mostly 503s on non-stream)
Spend: $14.3k weekly (+12% w/w)
Onboarding: 60% seats active, 2 new teams last week
Renewal risk: low->medium (cost chatter from finance)
```
ana_am: Thanks Elena — looping @sam_eng and @mike_sre. We have CloudBridge QBR next Tue, would like a short remediation plan.
sam_eng: looking at traces now — non-streaming p99 shows KV cache misses + model fallback to rwb-13b/host-slow-4. A few long tail requests retried twice. Probable causes: cold KV cache on dedicated pool + intermittant host swap.
mike_sre: we had background batch evals that overlapped peak window; eviction ran at 16:50 and nodes briefly hit 95% GPU mem, caused scheduler to migrate a couple pods.
sam_eng: short fixes: 1) enable aggressive KV warmup for chat.generate route (TTL 10m -> 30m), 2) set preferred-host pins during peak hours, 3) add fallback to rwb-7b-quant for non-critical routes.
ana_am: can you estimate ops impact and cost delta for switching more traffic to streaming-only for chat.generate? customer mentions they prefer streaming for responsiveness.
sam_eng: quick back-of-envelope: current traffic split ~40% streaming / 60% non-streaming. If we convert 60% -> streaming, token-serving cost drops ~8% (less re-send overhead), infra (GPU utilization) cost may rise by ~3% during peak due to more concurrent streams. Rough weekly impact: ~$1k saved net, but depends on burst tail.
mike_sre: i'll provision +1 node during 15:30-18:30 for Wed and add a p99 alert threshold for non-streaming chat.generate at 800ms. Also will throttle background evals during peak.
elena_cs: proposed plan: canary streaming-only 10:00-16:00 Wed; monitor p95/p99, errors, and spend. If stable, extend to daily peak window. @sam_eng @mike_sre please confirm and I'll airdrop notes to account.
sam_eng: confirmed, i'll add rollout (canary) + dashboard: grafana panel per route/model streaming vs non-stream.
mike_sre: confirmed, will add autoscale rule + pager for sustained p99>800ms.
latency-bot: Alert: p99 non-streaming chat.generate exceeded 900ms at 1839121234 (snapshot uploaded)
ana_am: great. i'll schedule the canary in calendar and add a short enablement playbook for the customer. tagging for QBR prep.
elena_cs: thanks team. i'll update CloudBridge with the canary plan and follow up with ticket link. end.
